mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals a misalignment in monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of these conditions on 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases over three consecutive months is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in the same period, the combined signal indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.5%
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.5% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of these conditions on 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a period of supply-side expansion, when INDPRO increases by more than 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS is below 2%, the combination signals a robust economic environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 2% is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint effect of these conditions on 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
